title: DirAccess.rename() will not update the references to the renamed file
body:
### Tested versions

- reproducible in v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

renaming a file using `DirAccess.rename()` will not update the references to the said file

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5f0fbc23-a0ab-4b41-b97a-af7c8b856b26

but if you rename the file directly in the FileSystem, the references are updated

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e9c6157c-5669-475a-b9ae-c7b760a33ded

### Steps to reproduce

Create a node that will reference the target file.
Then rename the target file using `DirAccess.rename()`.
The file will be renamed, but the node will still reference the old name of the target file.

See code and minimal project included below

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

```gdscript
@tool
class_name Main
extends Node2D

@export_tool_button("Rename") var rename = _rename
@export_tool_button("Rename Static") var rename_static = _rename_static


func _rename() -> void:
	var dir = DirAccess.open("res://")
	var error = dir.rename("res://icon.svg", "res://icon2.svg")
	print(error)

	EditorInterface.get_resource_filesystem().scan()							# refresh file system


func _rename_static() -> void:
	print(DirAccess.rename_absolute("res://icon.svg", "res://icon2.svg"))

	EditorInterface.get_resource_filesystem().scan()							# refresh file system
```

[Dir Access.rename.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26980472/Dir.Access.rename.zip)
